blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `deleteShippingOptionsStep`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.
This step deletes one or more shipping options.

children.name: DeleteShippingOptionsStepInput
children.description: The IDs of the shipping options to delete.

types.name: DeleteEntityInput
types.description:
The details of a data model's record whose linked records should be deleted. Usually used after the
data model's record is deleted.

The key is the data model's name. Its value is an object that has the ID of the data model's record.
